system_name.reference: We introduce INSTRUCTOR, a new method for computing text embeddings given task instructions: every text input is embedded together with instructions explaining the use case
system_name.matched_span: We introduce INSTRUCTOR, a new method for computing text embeddings given task instructions: every text input is embedded together with instructions explaining the use case

system_category.reference: INSTRUCTOR is a single embedder that can generate text embeddings tailored to different downstream tasks and domains, without any further training.
system_category.matched_span: INSTRUCTOR is a single embedder that can generate text embeddings tailored to different downstream tasks and domains, without any further training.

knowledge_representation.reference: Text embeddings represent discrete text inputs (e.g., sentences, documents, and code) as fixed-sized vectors that can be used in many downstream tasks.
knowledge_representation.matched_span: Text embeddings represent discrete text inputs (e.g., sentences, documents, and code) as fixed-sized vectors that can be used in many downstream tasks.

retrieval_mechanism.reference: We train INSTRUCTOR with a contrastive loss over all datasets that maximizes the similarity between semantically related text pairs while minimizing unrelated pairs.
retrieval_mechanism.matched_span: We train INSTRUCTOR with a contrastive loss over all datasets that maximizes the similarity between semantically related text pairs while minimizing unrelated pairs.

knowledge_source.reference: We then generate a fixed-sized, task-specific embedding E I ( I x , x ) by applying mean pooling to the last hidden representations over the tokens in x .
